name: tangi-eye
tagline_zh: 给 Agent 一双眼睛：摄像头、网络流、安卓手机都能取帧。先看全局再裁原分辨率细节，焊点、丝印、LED。
tagline_en: Give your agent eyes: USB cam, HTTP/MJPEG/RTSP, or Android via ADB. Overview first, then crop native-res.
desc_en: Give an agent eyes on the physical world: capture a USB camera, HTTP snapshot, MJPEG or RTSP frame, trigger an authorized Android camera via ADB, or import an existing JPEG/PNG locally or through Android ADB. Examine the overview first, then crop native-resolution evidence for embedded hardware, wiring and headers, chip markings, suspected component damage, indicator LEDs, multimeter readings, and
why_zh: 先出概览再裁原图，避免压缩伪影误导判断；多通道统一入口，硬件调试不用来回切工具。
why_en: Overview-then-crop keeps compression artifacts from fooling you; one entry for every capture path, so hardware debugging stays.
limit_zh: 只负责取帧和裁图，不做视觉识别。需要本机有可用的摄像头/网络流/ADB 环境；RTSP 依赖 OpenCV 编译支持。
limit_en: Captures and crops only—no vision analysis. Needs working camera/network/ADB on host; RTSP depends on OpenCV build. Crops must go to another model.
title_en: Grab frames from USB/RTSP/ADB, crop raw pixels for chip.
